label: SyncServer S600 GNSS NTP/PTP server
description: 1U enterprise Stratum-1 time server that disciplines from a multi-constellation GNSS receiver (GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou/Galileo) with TCXO, OCXO or rubidium holdover, and handles more than 10,000 hardware-timestamped NTP requests per second. Four isolated 100/1000BASE-T RJ45 LAN ports as standard; the GNSS antenna input, 1PPS output and DB9 console/timing serial ports are not Ethernet, and two 10GbE SFP+ ports are an option module.
